timeline.summary: Rajnikant S. Ajmera, Promoter, confirmed no new encumbrances on Ajmera Realty & Infra India shares by April 2, 2026, beyond prior disclosures.
On 23 April 2026, Ajmera Realty & Infra India announced CRISIL A-/Stable rating for ₹500 Cr bank loan facilities.
Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited’s earnings call for Q4 & FY26 results, led by **Dhaval Ajmera** and **Nitin Bavisi**, is scheduled for **May 25, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST**.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹431.13 Cr (+184.8% YoY), net profit ₹55.6 Cr (+119.9% YoY).

Ajmera Realty's FY26 investor presentation reported highest-ever annual sales value of ₹1,701 Cr (+57% YoY) and collections of ₹1,103 Cr (+71% YoY), with an FY27 launch pipeline of ₹6,324 Cr GDV and debt-to-equity at 0.53x.
On 29 May 2026, Ajmera Realty & Infra India filed the earnings call transcript for Q4 and FY26, reporting record pre-sales of ₹1,701 Cr and setting an FY27 sales guidance of ₹2,200 Cr.
Ajmera Realty & Infra India Limited to hold earnings call on November 03, 2026 for Q2FY27 results.
